about.heading: Our Mission
about.body: At VerifyAI, we believe in a world where truth prevails. Our team of leading researchers, software engineers, and journalists collaborate to stay one step ahead of synthetic media and coordinated disinformation campaigns. We are an independent organization committed to building transparent, unbiased AI tools for the public good.
